correctness.rationale: Direct coset Fourier diagonalization gives N explicit blocks and determinant |R|^2-|F|^2. Their singularity is equivalent to the primitive cube-root condition; character counts 2N/3 or 2N/9 give the exact complex nullities and affine-line combinatorics gives all support multiplicities. Independent finite modular ranks matched 1653 predicted test cases, but the proof is not reliant on them.

originality.rationale: The 2013 all-Cayley Fourier factorization and the 2016 symmetric cyclic-dihedral spectrum are explicitly treated as known. The new claim is the explicit all-support rank classification and exact multiplicity census on elementary-abelian inversion semidirect products. The general formulas do not state these evaluations and counts, and full-text/record comparisons did not identify an equivalent closed census. Historical equivalent-specialization risk persists.
residual_risks: General spectral decompositions are mathematically stronger on input domain; a pre-existing specialized corollary or unindexed generalized-dihedral rank table could encompass the new census.

value.rationale: Convolution rank is a natural finite-group harmonic invariant representing loss of information under a three-tap filter. The theorem yields a complete new rank and support census for an infinite noncommutative family, identifies all kernel dimensions and establishes a strict prime-three obstruction; it is not a single isolated computation.
